summary: Iter30 — Tested new WhatsApp Diagnose delivery-status endpoint + UI, plus light webhook lifecycle regression. All backend and frontend checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: wa_cloud.py routes file grew to ~265 lines and mixes webhook + admin + diagnose + test-send logic — consider splitting webhook handlers vs admin introspection into two modules once it grows further.

check_app_subscriptions() and other Graph helpers duplicate httpx.AsyncClient boilerplate — the existing _graph_get helper could be reused (currently uses user access_token so a small parameter would let it accept app access tokens too).

diagnose endpoint performs sequential Graph calls (get_subscribed_apps + check_app_subscriptions) with 20s timeouts each — could hang up to 40s+ on Graph outages; consider gathering in parallel with asyncio.gather() and shorter timeouts.
Pre-login /api/auth/me 401 is logged as a console error on the login page — cosmetic but noisy in production; suppress or gate the /me call until token exists.
seed_data_creation: None permanent. Iter29 fixture briefly overrides settings.whatsapp_cloud.app_secret and restores after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoint GET /api/admin/whatsapp/diagnose is implemented in /app/backend/routes/wa_cloud.py. It returns {verdict, next_step, checks[], callback_url, waba_id}. UI wired via [data-testid='wa-diagnose-button'|'wa-diagnose-result'|'wa-diagnose-verdict'] on Admin → WhatsApp. On preview verdict='healthy' due to matched_hits>0 from iter29 seed webhooks; the 'app_webhook' check shows ok=false with 'App ID and App Secret required' — EXPECTED on preview (app_id not configured).
rca of the issue: The diagnose tool itself works end-to-end on preview and correctly reports 'healthy'. The user's 'stuck at Sent' symptom is a Meta-side config issue (webhook not pointed at prod CRM or 'messages' field not subscribed) — the new tool will show them exactly which check fails and how to fix it. No CRM-side bug to fix.
